data.title: Sr Engineer II, Software Development - Switch
data.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Switching Software Engineer to lead innovation and development of cutting-edge managed switching solutions for small and medium enterprise (SME) markets. This role requires deep technical expertise in switching software architecture and product-level understanding to drive breakthrough innovations in cost-effective, feature-rich managed switches from 10GB to 400GB targeting SME deployments. 

Key Responsibilities

- Product Innovation Leadership: Drive breakthrough innovations in SME-focused switching features including zero-touch provisioning, cloud-based management integration, and AI-powered network optimization
 - SME Feature Development: Lead development of enterprise-grade features optimized for SME deployments: simplified network segmentation, automated VLAN provisioning, intelligent traffic prioritization, and plug-and-play enterprise security
 - Cost-Performance Optimization: Innovate cost-effective solutions that deliver enterprise functionality at SME price points while maintaining performance
 - Customer-Driven Innovation: Lead research into SME networking pain points and develop innovative software solutions for simplified network management
 - Platform Differentiation: Drive technical differentiation through innovative features like ML-based network anomaly detection, automated capacity planning, and predictive maintenance for SME environments
 - Market-Focused Architecture: Design switching architectures that balance advanced enterprise features with SME deployment simplicity and cost constraints
 - Innovation Partnerships: Collaborate with product management and field teams to identify market opportunities and drive product innovation
 - Competitive Analysis: Lead technical competitive analysis and drive innovation to maintain market leadership in SME managed switching

SME Market Product Knowledge

- SME Network Challenges: Deep understanding of SME networking constraints including limited IT staff, budget sensitivity, and simplified management requirements
 - Market Positioning: Knowledge of SME switching market dynamics, competitive landscape, and differentiation opportunities
 - Enterprise Feature Adaptation: Expertise in adapting complex enterprise features for simplified SME deployment and management
 - TCO Optimization: Understanding of total cost of ownership considerations for SME customers including deployment, management, and maintenance costs

Advanced Switching Features for SME Market

- Intelligent Auto-Configuration: Zero-touch VLAN setup, automated QoS policies, and self-configuring network segmentation
 - Cloud Integration: Seamless integration with cloud management platforms and hybrid cloud networking
 - Security Automation: Automated threat detection, network access control, and security policy enforcement optimized for SME environments
 - Performance Intelligence: ML-driven bandwidth optimization, traffic analytics, and capacity planning for growing SME networks
 - Simplified Network Virtualization: Easy-to-deploy network segmentation and micro-segmentation for SME security requirements
 - Branch Office Connectivity: Advanced SD-WAN integration, site-to-site VPN automation, and centralized branch management
 - Guest Network Management: Sophisticated guest access control with time-based policies, bandwidth limiting, and secure isolation
 - IoT Device Management: Automated IoT device discovery, classification, and policy enforcement for SME environments
 - Voice/Video Optimization: Advanced QoS for unified communications, video conferencing optimization, and real-time application prioritization
 - Network Analytics: Comprehensive network visibility, user behavior analytics, and automated reporting for SME IT teams

Innovation & Technical Leadership

- Emerging Technology Integration: Drive adoption of AI/ML, edge computing, and IoT integration in SME switching solutions
 - Patent Development: Lead development of patentable innovations in SME networking and switching technology
 - Industry Standards: Contribute to industry standards development with focus on SME networking requirements
 - Technical Thought Leadership: Represent company technical innovation at industry conferences and technical forums

Expert Technical Requirements

- Switching Architecture Mastery: Deep expertise in switching ASIC architectures optimized for SME market requirements
 - Advanced Broadcom SDK: Expert-level knowledge of Broadcom SDK optimization for cost-effective, high-performance SME solutions
 - Product-Level Systems: Advanced experience with complete product development from conception to market delivery
 - Innovation Methodologies: Experience with design thinking, rapid prototyping, and customer-driven innovation processes

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering
 - 10 to 12 years of embedded switching software development with focus on product delivery
 - 5+ years of experience developing SME networking products or similar market-focused solutions
 - Proven track record of delivering innovative networking products to market with measurable business impact
 - Experience with customer-driven innovation and market-focused product development

data.title: Avionics Hardware Lead
data.description:
Company Overview

At Cosmoserve Space, we are pioneering a cleaner, more sustainable future for space exploration through innovative technology focused on active debris removal. Our mission is to safeguard the orbital environment by developing high-tech, cost-effective solutions that lead the market in addressing the growing challenge of space debris. With a passionate team of engineers and a commitment to cutting-edge engineering, Cosmoserve is driving the next generation of responsible space activities, ensuring that the space remains accessible for future missions. 

Position: Avionics Hardware Lead

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: CEO

Location: Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Summary

We are looking for an Avionics Hardware Lead to own the onboard electronics of our spacecraft, from system specification to tested flight hardware. The role covers defining avionics requirements from mission goals and designing microcontroller-based circuits, power electronics and subsystem interfaces. The Lead will drive circuit simulation, PCB layout, component selection and testing, and ensure every board meets space-grade quality and reliability standards. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Lead will head a team of engineers, set design and documentation standards, and work closely with the GNC, AIT and QA teams to deliver reliable hardware on schedule. 

Key Responsibilities

•  Translate mission and system goals into clear avionics system specifications. 

•  Lead design and development of electronic circuits built around microcontrollers. 

•  Run circuit simulations and review PCB layouts before fabrication. 

•  Select, design and test low-power DC-DC converters and power distribution circuits. 

•  Define and implement interfaces between avionics units over serial and parallel buses, with signal conditioning using op-amps and current-to-voltage converters. 

•  Select components suitable for space applications, including qualified use of industrial-grade parts. 

•  Apply QA practices in line with MIL-STD-883, ISO and AS9100 requirements. 

•  Prepare and maintain design documents, test procedures and reports. 

•  Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of avionics engineers. 

Qualifications

Education: BE / B. Tech or M. Tech in ECE or EEE with specialisation in Electronics / Instrumentation. 

Work Experience: 8 to 10 years

Required Skill Set (Major)

•        Experience in design and development of electronic circuits with microcontrollers. 

•        Experience in preparing system specifications for system goals and functions. 

•        Good knowledge of circuit simulation in KiCad, PSpice or similar tools. 

•        Knowledge of PCB layout. 

•        Knowledge of power electronics such as low-power DC-DC converters, including selection and testing. 

•        Good knowledge of interfacing various avionics systems using serial or parallel buses, op-amps, current-to-voltage converters, etc. 

•        Knowledge of QA aspects related to MIL 1553 STD, ISO and AS standards. 

•        Good knowledge of component selection for space applications. 

•        Knowledge of building systems for space using industrial-grade components. 

•        Experience in leading a team of engineers. 

•        Good documentation aptitude. 

•          Added Advantage

1.       General knowledge of space systems for satellite building. 

2.       Firmware knowledge

Required Soft Skills

•          Ability to lead, guide and motivate a team of engineers. 

•          Strong sense of ownership from design through to testing. 

•          Clear communication with engineers, management and vendors. 

•          Works well with GNC, mechanical, AIT and QA teams. 

•          Methodical approach to debugging and root cause analysis. 

•          High attention to detail and discipline in following quality processes. 

•          Good planning and prioritisation in a fast-paced startup. 

•          Adaptable to changing requirements and limited resources. 

•          Willing to mentor juniors and give constructive design reviews.

Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation. 

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors. 

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development. 

Key Responsibilities

PLC Software Development

- Understand PLC Software Development

 - Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems. 
 - Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms. 
 - Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration

- Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I). 
 - Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions.

Continuous Improvement

data.title: Design Verification - Technical Leader
data.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50, 000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Digital Verification Engineer to take on a Technical Leader role within our Imaging verification team. The candidate will drive verification strategy and closure for complex digital IPs in imaging and automotive subsystems, mentor junior engineers, and act as the technical point of contact for verification across cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end verification strategy, planning, and closure for one or more complex IPs/subsystems. 
 - Architect and review UVM-based verification environments, ensuring reusability and scalability across projects. 
 - Drive functional and code coverage closure; define coverage models and identify verification gaps early in the cycle. 
 - Lead protocol-level verification efforts (e. g. , I3C, MIPI, AMBA), including VIP evaluation, integration, and debug. 
 - Apply the use of formal verification techniques (e. g. , JasperGold) to complement simulation-based verification, particularly for FSM and control-logic-heavy blocks. 
 - Review test plans, testbenches, and verification collateral authored by team members; provide technical guidance on methodology and debug approaches. 
 - Interface with design, architecture, DFT, and software teams to clarify specification ambiguities and drive design-for-verification practices. 
 - Identify and resolve spec ambiguities/errata; work with IP/protocol working groups where applicable. 
 - Mentor and technically guide junior verification engineers; support their ramp-up on tools, methodology, and protocols. 
 - Drive process improvements: regression infrastructure, debug efficiency, coverage methodology, and verification reuse. 
 - Communicate verification status, risks, and closure plans to management and stakeholders. 
 - Support root-cause analysis of silicon/post-silicon issues traced back to verification gaps, where relevant. 

Required Skills

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, or Computer Engineering (VLSI specialization preferred). 
 - 5-7 years of experience in digital design/IP verification, with demonstrated ownership of verification closure for at least one complex IP or subsystem. 
 - Strong expertise in System Verilog and UVM methodology - testbench architecture, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models. 
 - Proven experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and assertion-based verification (SVA); ability to define coverage models from specification. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard simulation tools (VCS, Xcelium, or Questa) and debug tools. 
 - Experience with formal verification tools and methodology (e. g. , JasperGold) for FSM, connectivity, or control-logic verification. 
 - Solid understanding of one or more protocols such as I3C, I2C, SPI, AMBA, MIPI-CSI, or similar interconnect/interface standards, including VIP-based verification. 
 - Strong scripting skills (Python, Perl, or TCL) for automation, flow development, and regression management. 
 - Ability to read and interpret design specifications, RTL, and identify verification risk areas independently. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Experience mentoring or technically leading a small team of verification engineers. 
 - Exposure to mutation testing or other coverage-quality assessment techniques. 
 - Familiarity with low-power verification (UPF/CPF) and Gate Level simulations. 
 - Experience working with EDA vendors (e. g. , Cadence, Synopsys) for tool/methodology support and issue resolution. 
 - Prior contribution to internal verification methodology documents, guidelines, or reusable verification IP (VIP) development. 
 - Experience working in a globally distributed team environment. 

Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous or under-specified requirements. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to present technical status and risk clearly to management. 
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive closure under deadlines. 
 - Collaborative approach to working with design, architecture, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Exposure to AI/ML assisted verification techniques to improve verification productivity and efficiency. 

What We Offer

- A technical leadership track with visibility into IP-level and subsystem-level verification strategy. 
 - Opportunity to shape verification methodology, including formal and protocol verification practices. 
 - Mentorship and people-development opportunities within a growing team. 
 - Exposure to advanced verification domains including formal verification and next-generation Security IP and systems. 
 - Collaborative, cross-functional work environment with global teams. 

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance. 

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 

To discover more, visit st. com/careers.

data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Sr Manager
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of your career building and verifying silicon that actually ships, not just passes simulation. You know that verification is where the real complexity lives, where assumptions break, and where a good engineer becomes a great one by catching the corner case no one thought to write down. Leading a team is not about delegation for you, it is about building engineers who think critically, ask the right questions, and take ownership of the hard problems. 

You have been in the room when a design looked perfect on paper but fell apart under real stimulus. That experience taught you to build verification environments that stress the design in ways the architect did not anticipate. Mentorship matters to you because you remember the engineers who shaped how you think, and you want to do that for others. 

Managing multiple projects does not overwhelm you because you have learned to prioritize what matters, push back when timelines do not match reality, and keep your team focused on the work that moves the needle. You are technical enough to review a testbench architecture and organizational enough to keep three projects on track without losing sight of the people doing the work. 

At Synopsys, you will lead verification for complex ASIC designs that power the products our customers build, and you will do it with a team that values depth, rigor, and getting it right. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a team of design and verification engineers in Noida, managing performance, growth, and day-to-day execution across multiple ASIC projects
 - Own the verification strategy and environment architecture for complex, high-speed protocol designs, defining testplans and coverage models that catch real issues
 - Drive technical decisions around verification flows, including SystemVerilog, UVM, behavioral modeling, and coverage-driven verification
 - Work directly with architects, RTL designers, and VIP teams to align on design intent, resolve ambiguities, and ensure functional correctness before tapeout
 - Identify design gaps and propose corrective actions when documented functionality does not match implementation or customer requirements
 - Reproduce and resolve customer-reported issues through deep technical analysis, working backward from symptoms to root cause
 - Continuously improve verification methodologies, tooling, and execution efficiency across the team

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver functionally correct, high-performance silicon designs that ship to customers and power next-generation products
 - Build a team culture where engineers grow technically, take ownership, and solve hard problems without waiting for perfect direction
 - Reduce time-to-market by catching design issues early through rigorous verification and well-architected testbenches
 - Strengthen cross-functional collaboration between design, architecture, and verification, ensuring alignment and reducing late-stage surprises
 - Influence verification best practices across Synopsys, shaping how teams approach coverage, automation, and testbench design
 - Resolve customer issues faster and more thoroughly, building trust and long-term partnerships
 - Set the technical bar for what great verification looks like, raising the standard across projects and teams

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC design and verification, with deep expertise in high-speed protocols and complex digital systems
 - Strong proficiency in Verilog, VHDL, and SystemVerilog for RTL design and verification
 - Proven experience building UVM-based verification environments, including testbench architecture, coverage analysis, and constraint-driven stimulus
 - Solid scripting skills in BASH, TCSH, PERL, PYTHON, or TCL for automation, flow development, and productivity tooling
 - Track record of managing and mentoring engineering teams, balancing technical leadership with people development
 - Experience working through ambiguous requirements, incomplete specs, or shifting priorities without losing momentum

Who You Are

- You can review a verification plan and immediately spot what is missing, whether it is a corner case, a coverage gap, or an unrealistic timeline
 - You give feedback that makes engineers better, not just feedback that checks a box during a review cycle
 - You are comfortable saying no when a project plan does not match reality, and you can explain why in a way that moves the conversation forward
 - You manage multiple projects without losing track of the details that matter, knowing when to dive deep and when to trust your team
 - You write and communicate clearly in English, whether it is a technical document, a status update, or a difficult conversation with a stakeholder
 - You adapt quickly when priorities shift, helping your team stay focused on what matters most without creating chaos

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions. 

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams. 

About Crafter

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise. 

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter's visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.   

Role Overview

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams. 

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders. 

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product. 

Key Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
 - Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
 - Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
 - Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
 - Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
 - Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
 - Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
 - Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
 - Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
 - Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
 - Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
 - Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

Experience And Profile

- 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
 - Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
 - Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
 - Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
 - Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
 - Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

Skills And Attributes

- Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
 - Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
 - Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
 - Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
 - Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
 - Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
 - Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis - particularly under production pressure
 - Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
 - A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

Recruitment Process

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through: 

- ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
 - ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
 - Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussionsThis process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization. 

What do we offer

- Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
 - Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
 - A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
 - A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growthAs a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one. 

To apply you can send your resume to prashant. musale@erelego. com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

data.title: Lead AI Engineer (LLM Agents)-Immediate
data.description:
Location: Remote (India), working with a San Francisco-based founding team

Engagement: Full-time, long-term, dedicated

Experience: 8-10+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years building production LLM applications and agents

Openings: 1

Time zone: Flexible hours, with a daily live overlap with the founders

About the ClientOur client is an early-stage AI startup in San Francisco, founded by alumni of Harvard and MIT. The company is in stealth. It is building an agent-based product that takes complex, high-stakes paperwork off the hands of US families: working out what applies to them, researching official sources, handling correspondence and following up over weeks, with every step checked and backed by evidence. 

Parts of the product are already built and running in test. The team today is two co-founders and one engineer. As Lead Engineer, you will be the most senior technical person on the team. You will be the founders' technical partner, own the architecture, and lead the product into production with real users. 

The Role: CTO Judgement, Builder's HandsWe are looking for someone with the judgement of a CTO who still writes code every day. Expect roughly 70-80% of your week to be hands-on: designing, building, reviewing and shipping. The rest goes into technical direction, standards and growing the team. 

•      Own the architecture end to end, and be accountable for how the system behaves in production. 

•      Be the founders' technical partner: shape the roadmap, make build-vs-buy calls, size work honestly, and push back when something is the wrong thing to build. 

•      Set the engineering bar for code review, testing, evals, security and releases. 

•      Lead and mentor the engineers on the team, and help interview future hires. 

•      Lead from the front in production: when something breaks, you're on it, and you make sure it doesn't break the same way twice. 

This role is not for you if you haven't shipped production code in the last 12 months, or you'd rather manage engineers than build alongside them. 

What You'll Own•      Agent platform architecture: design the agent harness, with tool-calling loops that have budgets, stop conditions and failure recovery, and a check on every output before it reaches a user or an outside party. 

•      Model layer: route across model vendors with fallbacks, manage prompts and versions, and weigh the cost, latency and quality behind each choice. 

•      Durable, long-running workflows: agent runs that wait days or weeks for a reply, survive restarts and deployments, and can be audited afterwards. 

•      Evaluation and safety: build the eval framework that decides when an agent is correct, when it can act without a person approving, and when it must escalate. Trace and observe every run. 

•      Data, security and compliance: store sensitive personal records securely, with row-level access control, encryption, secrets management and audit trails. Get the platform ready for the security reviews (e. g. SOC 2) that customers and partners will ask for. 

•      Infrastructure and reliability: AWS and Azure architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. Build performance-critical services in Go, Rust or Python where TypeScript is not the right tool. 

•      Full-stack product: you will still ship features end to end, from the agent to the screen a family sees on phone or desktop. 

Milestones•      First 30 days: ship code in week one. Review the existing system, then agree an architecture, a risk list and a 90-day technical plan with the founders. 

•      By 90 days: the core agent harness, eval framework and production infrastructure are in place, and the first real users are live. 

•      By six months: the platform runs in production with real users, with measurable reliability and eval coverage, and the team ships to your standard. 

Core RequirementsSeniority and leadership•      8-10+ years of professional software engineering. In recent years you have worked as a tech lead, principal or staff engineer, founding engineer or CTO in early-stage startups, and still written production code throughout. 

•      You have owned the architecture of a production system from early design through scale, and lived with the consequences of your decisions. 

•      0-to-1 experience: you have taken a product from prototype to real users, at an early-stage startup or on a new product line. 

•      You have led or mentored a small team (2-8 engineers) without big-company process around you. 

Agents and AI systems (hands-on, in production)•      2+ years building LLM applications, including at least one agent system you architected, shipped to real users and ran in production. 

•      Deep understanding of agent architecture: 

-      tool and function calling

-      planning vs. execution, and single vs. multi-agent designs

-      context and memory management

-      human-in-the-loop approvals and guardrails

-      defence against prompt injection

•      You know the frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, MCP) well enough to know when to write the loop yourself. 

•      Structured output and failure handling: you get typed, schema-validated output from models, and you handle the cases where the model gets it wrong with retries, repair and fallbacks. 

•      Evaluation at production level: you have built eval sets and graders (including calibrated LLM-as-judge), wired regression gates into CI, and used the results to decide whether to ship. 

•      Running models in production economically: caching, routing, batching, and choosing the right model for each task. 

•      Designing around interfaces, so a model vendor, cloud or database can be swapped without a rewrite. 

Engineering depth•      Expert TypeScript across the stack: Node. js on the server and React in the browser. 

•      Production depth in at least one of Go, Rust or Python. 

•      Designing and running systems on AWS or Azure, with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi). 

•      PostgreSQL: data modelling, query performance and row-level security. 

•      Durable workflow engines and queues in production (e. g. Temporal, Inngest, Step Functions, Celery). 

•      Security engineering for sensitive personal data: threat modelling, access control, encryption, secrets handling and audit logging. 

•      Observability and incident response: tracing, metrics, alerting and post-mortems. 

•      Automated testing as a habit, including tests of behaviour that depends on a model. 

•      Heavy daily use of AI coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). You set the team's standard for reviewing what they produce. 

Nice to Have•      Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure. 

•      A previous founder, co-founder or CTO role at a startup. 

•      Research agents that search the web and cite sources; browser automation or voice agents; MCP servers you have built. 

•      Document processing: OCR and pulling data from scans and PDFs. 

•      Compliance work such as SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR. 

•      Products in high-stakes, regulated areas such as legal, financial, government or healthcare paperwork. 

•      Public repos, technical writing, talks or open-source work on agent systems. This will make your application stand out. 

What We Look For Beyond Code•      A founder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, owns outcomes, and cares about the people using the product. They are going through a hard time, so every screen, message and automated action matters. 

•      "Evidence before claims": when you say something works, you show the test, the log or the screenshot. 

•      A clear technical communicator: you can explain a trade-off to non-technical founders in plain words, and write a design doc engineers can build from. 

•      Excellent written and spoken English. You are comfortable on video: a daily stand-up with cameras on, plus short recorded video updates. 

•      A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and your own laptop (32 GB RAM preferred, disk encryption on). 

Working HoursThe founders are in San Francisco, and the wider team works across time zones. You should be open to any of these patterns (India time), agreed with the founders: 

•      9: 30 a. m. - 6: 30 p. m. 

•      2: 30 p. m. - 11: 30 p. m. 

•      8: 00 a. m. - 5: 00 p. m. 

Engagement Details•      Full-time, long-term engagement through Metric Tree Labs, working only with this client as part of its core team. 

•      Target start: as early as possible. The joining date is agreed on selection. 

•      Senior, competitive compensation, reviewed after six months.

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Staff Software Engineer, Endpoint Agent (Development & Automation Testing)

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms. 
 - Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development. 
 - Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence. 
 - Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments. 
 - Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs. 
 - Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in C# and . NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services. 
 - Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks 
 - Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities. 
 - Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks. 
 - Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with RMM, UEM, EDR, XDR, endpoint security, or device management products. 
 - Knowledge of C, C++, Rust, Go 
 - Experience with Microsoft Intune, Apple MDM, Android Enterprise, or Linux management platforms. 
 - Knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, Python, AppleScript, or other scripting technologies. 
 - Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, or system-level validation tooling. 
 - Experience working with virtualization, containerization, or automated device provisioning environments. 
 - Familiarity with endpoint telemetry, diagnostics, observability, and monitoring systems. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Endpoint Software Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds secure, scalable, and high-quality endpoint software. 
 - Owns features end-to-end from design through production support. 
 - Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality. 
 - Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation. 
 - Solves complex customer, platform, and operating system challenges. 
 - Improves the reliability, performance, security, and maintainability of endpoint agents. 
 - Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Support, Security, Platform, and Engineering teams. 
 - Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery. 
 - Continuously grows expertise in operating systems, endpoint management, systems programming, and modern software development practices.

Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world. 

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud's Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers. 

Responsibilities

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About the Role: 

The Data Catalog team is the semantic intelligence layer of Rippling's platform. Our mission is to make Rippling's data schema - spanning millions of fields across every product - discoverable, trustworthy, and actionable for both humans and AI. We are the authoritative source of truth for "data about data" within Rippling. 

We sit at the intersection of platform infrastructure and AI, powering core product surfaces like Workflow Automator, Reports, Supergroups, and Data Manager, while increasingly serving as the data backbone for Rippling's AI products - including the AI Assistant and AI Field Selection features. 

What We Build

The team delivers across four strategic pillars: 

- Data Discoverability: Catalog browse, search, and field-selection experiences used throughout Rippling, enabling users to find the most relevant data for their use case across a vast and growing schema. 
 - Data Enrichment: AI-generated semantic descriptions, glossary tagging, sampled values, usage signals, and RQL formula examples - adding business context that makes raw schema meaningful. 
 - Data Governance: PII classification, sensitive data flagging, compliance tagging, and integration with access controls and auditing infrastructure. 
 - Data Lifecycle: Upstream and downstream dependency tracking, lineage visualization, and event-driven metadata sync to ensure the Catalog stays live and accurate as Rippling's data model evolves. 

You will: 

- Lead the Technical Roadmap: Design, develop, and maintain internet-scale, highly distributed systems and scalable services for the Data Catalog team. 
 - Think for the Future: Prototype with the newest AI tools to think about primitives that will be used to democratize development with Rippling. 
 - Solve for Scale: Tackle our growing size and load and understand where we can be doing less work. 
 - Own the Stack: Work deeply with infrastructure to manage complex distributed systems that power every Rippling product. 
 - Operate as a Tech Lead: This is a "pure engineering" team. You will partner directly with other Platform Tech Leads and EMs (your primary customers) to define how Data Catalog's core infrastructure evolves. 

Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of experience in software development, preferably in fast-paced, dynamic environments. 
 - Solid understanding of CS fundamentals, architectures, and design patterns. 
 - Proven track record in building large-scale applications, APIs, and developer tools. 
 - Excellent at cross-functional collaboration, able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical partners. 
 - You thrive in a product-focused environment and are passionate about making an impact on customer experience. 

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling. com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

Title: Staff / Senior Staff CAD & Methodology Engineer(Digital Impementation & SignOff)

Location Greater Bengaluru/Hybrid/Remote

About Company: 

We are hiring for organization which is leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. Its robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today's best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. It was launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems. 

Job Description: 

As a Staff / Senior Staff CAD & Methodology Engineer, you will be the resident expert in Innovus and Tempus, responsible for developing, debugging, and continually accelerating our RTL-to-GDSII and timing signoff flows. You will work closely with Physical Design and STA leads to eliminate bottlenecks, automate manual tasks, and push the limits of EDA capabilities at advanced process nodes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Flow Architecture & Automation: Architect, develop, and maintain a highly automated, robust, and scalable physical design and signoff flow from synthesis through GDSII, optimized for AI accelerator architectures. 
 - Innovus Methodology: Drive advanced physical design methodologies in Cadence Innovus. Optimize recipes for floorplanning, placement, Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), routing, and power grid implementation to squeeze out maximum PPA. 
 - Tempus Signoff Integration: Own the STA and timing signoff methodology using Cadence Tempus. Implement and optimize Distributed Multi-Scenario Analysis (DMSA), advanced OCV methodologies, and automated Tempus ECO flows to ensure rapid timing closure. 
 - Turnaround Time (TAT) Reduction: Identify inefficiencies in the daily execution of block and top-level implementation. Develop Python and Tcl-based automation, database parsers, and custom utilities to drastically reduce tool runtime and engineering debug time. 
 - Tool & Vendor Interface: Act as the primary technical liaison with Cadence. Drive tool evaluations, beta testing of new features, and resolution of critical tool bugs or limitations to ensure continuous flow stability. 
 - Mentorship & Support: Serve as the final escalation point for the PD and Timing teams regarding flow-related issues. Document methodologies clearly and mentor junior engineers on tool usage and flow mechanics. Requirements & Qualifications

- Experience: 9 to 14 years of industry experience in ASIC/SOC physical design, with a primary focus on CAD, TFM (Tools, Flows, and Methodology), or flow automation. 
 - Cadence Mastery: 
 - Deep, production-proven expertise with Cadence Innovus (Implementation) and Cadence Tempus (Signoff STA). 
 - Strong understanding of internal tool mechanics, database access commands (dbGet), and advanced tool configuration. 
 - Scripting & Software Skills: Expert-level proficiency in Tcl and Python. Strong background in Makefile generation, shell scripting, and version control (Git/Perforce). 
 - Domain Knowledge: Thorough understanding of deep sub-micron physical design concepts (advanced node DRCs, cross-talk, electromigration, IR drop) and the theoretical foundations of Static Timing Analysis. 
 - Startup Mindset: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where flow requirements evolve rapidly as the architecture matures. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. 

Contact Details: 

SUMIT S. B. 

sumit@mulyatech. com

data.title: Principal AI & DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Are you a seasoned technologist who thrives at the intersection of artificial intelligence and business transformation? Do you have a proven track record of turning complex AI/ML concepts into scalable, production-grade systems that move the needle for enterprise operations? If so, we want to hear from you. 

We are looking for a Principal AI & DevOps Engineer to join our team - a strategic builder and technical leader who brings deep expertise, sharp instincts, and a bias for action. You won't just execute; you'll shape the direction of how we architect, deploy, and scale AI/ML solutions across the organization. 

What You'll Own

First 30 Days - Strategic Discovery & Architecture Assessment

Enterprise Systems Audit: Rapidly assess our existing technical landscape, business architecture, and active AI workstreams - bringing your experience to quickly identify gaps, redundancies, and high-leverage opportunities others might miss. 

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Engagement: Lead structured discovery sessions across business units to surface operational friction points and define a prioritized roadmap for AI/ML intervention - drawing on your experience translating business pain into technical solutions. 

Technology Evaluation & Benchmarking: Apply your deep knowledge of emerging AI/ML technologies, industry trends, and software engineering best practices to evaluate our current toolchain and recommend improvements with clear rationale. 

Strategic Value Mapping: Deliver a well-reasoned assessment of where generative AI can reduce manual overhead, unlock creative capacity, or create competitive advantage - backed by your own experience doing exactly that. 

Beyond 30 Days - Build, Lead, and Scale

Full-Stack AI Application Development: Architect and deliver production-quality, full-stack AI-powered applications - leveraging Python backends and JavaScript/Flutter frontends - with a focus on performance, maintainability, and user experience informed by years of hands-on delivery. 

Context Engineering & LLM Optimization: Design and implement sophisticated context engineering strategies - orchestrating enterprise data, memory systems, tool outputs, and prompt chaining within LLM context windows to produce accurate, structured, and reliable outputs at scale. 

End-to-End Pipeline Ownership: Own the full deployment lifecycle. Design, implement, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines for LLM applications - including automated testing frameworks - applying best practices you've refined over your career. 

Data Engineering & ML Lifecycle Management: Drive data quality, pipeline integrity, and dataset governance to fuel deployed ML models - bringing mature engineering discipline to data validation, query optimization, and model input management. 

Observability & Performance Engineering: Establish robust monitoring frameworks using tools like AWS CloudWatch, define and track AI performance against business KPIs, and deliver executive-ready dashboards and reports that connect system health to business outcomes. 

Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing: Mentor peers through code reviews, lead architectural discussions, and present fully operational solutions during stakeholder demos - translating complex AI/ML architecture into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent field
 - 8-12 years of hands-on experience in full-stack development
 - Proven DevOps & Automation expertise: Deep experience with CI/CD tooling, deployment workflows, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in production environments

This role is designed for someone who brings their own perspective, methodology, and technical philosophy - not just executes a playbook. We value engineers who have strong opinions, loosely held, and the experience to back them up.

data.title: Node.js & QA Automation Engineer - Corporate Banking
data.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Node. js Software Engineer with QA Automation expertise and 7+ years of experience in software development, automated testing, and quality engineering. The role will support Corporate Banking and Transaction Banking applications through backend development, API and microservices integration, test automation, and production support. The position will contribute to business objectives by delivering scalable and secure applications, improving automated test coverage, validating transaction processing capabilities, and supporting reliable application modernization and migration initiatives. 

Software Requirements

Required

- Minimum 7+ years of experience in software engineering, Node. js development, QA automation, or related technology roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Node. js using a current and supported version. 
 - Experience designing, developing, and maintaining backend applications. 
 - Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices. 
 - Experience with automated testing frameworks and reusable automation components. 
 - Experience performing functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Experience automating API and UI testing activities. 
 - Familiarity with software development lifecycle and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience with source control, code reviews, defect tracking, test reporting, and release processes. 
 - Ability to write clean, scalable, reusable, maintainable, and testable code. 
 - Experience supporting application enhancement, maintenance, troubleshooting, and production activities. 
 - Understanding of application performance, scalability, security, and reliability considerations. 

Preferred

- Experience with Corporate Banking and Transaction Banking applications. 
 - Experience with Integrated Global Transaction Banking (IGTB) products. 
 - Experience working on migration programs, including application modernization, system migration, data validation, and regression testing. 
 - Knowledge of banking integrations, payment flows, transaction processing, and corporate banking services. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native development, containers, monitoring, and observability tools. 
 - Experience with performance testing, security testing, and service reliability practices. 
 - Knowledge of test data management, data reconciliation, and migration validation. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, maintain, and support backend applications using Node. js. 
 - Build, integrate, and consume RESTful APIs and microservices. 
 - Develop reusable, maintainable, and scalable application components. 
 - Collaborate with Business Analysts, Architects, Product Owners, development teams, and testing teams to understand requirements and define solutions. 
 - Support banking integrations and transaction-processing modules. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and reusable test automation frameworks. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Automate API and UI testing activities to improve coverage, reliability, and delivery efficiency. 
 - Investigate application defects, test failures, and production issues and implement appropriate fixes. 
 - Participate in application enhancement, maintenance, migration, release, and production support activities. 
 - Validate application behavior, data integrity, integrations, and transaction outcomes during migration and release activities. 
 - Optimize application performance, scalability, maintainability, and security. 
 - Participate in code reviews, test reviews, technical discussions, defect analysis, and release validation. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve development practices, automation coverage, testing efficiency, and application reliability. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, test evidence, automation results, defect records, and operational procedures. 
 - Consider secure, efficient, maintainable, and sustainable use of application and test infrastructure. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Node. js using a current and supported version. 
 - Strong understanding of JavaScript and asynchronous programming. 
 - Knowledge of modules, error handling, promises, event-driven programming, and application performance. 
 - Ability to write clean, reusable, scalable, maintainable, and testable code. 
 - Understanding of programming practices for backend services, APIs, and microservices. 

Preferred

- TypeScript. 
 - SQL for data validation and application support. 
 - Shell scripting for automation and deployment support. 
 - Knowledge of scripting practices used in test automation and operational support. 

Databases/Data Management

Essential

- Understanding of relational databases and application data structures. 
 - Knowledge of data validation, data integrity, data mapping, and data reconciliation. 
 - Ability to analyze application data, test data, migration data, and transaction results. 
 - Understanding of data requirements for banking integrations and transaction-processing systems. 
 - Awareness of secure data handling and data privacy requirements. 

Preferred

- Experience with SQL queries, joins, filters, aggregations, and data comparison. 
 - Knowledge of NoSQL databases. 
 - Experience with data migration validation and reconciliation. 
 - Familiarity with transaction, customer, account, payment, and corporate banking data. 
 - Knowledge of test data preparation, masking, and controlled use of production-like data. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

- Understanding of cloud computing concepts and application infrastructure. 
 - Knowledge of application deployment, scalability, availability, monitoring, configuration, and operational support. 
 - Ability to support applications and automated test execution across development, test, and production environments. 

Preferred

- Experience deploying Node. js applications and automation frameworks on cloud platforms. 
 - Familiarity with containers, orchestration, managed databases, storage, networking, and identity services. 
 - Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, automation, and cost optimization. 
 - Awareness of efficient and sustainable use of application and test environments. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

- Experience with Node. js backend frameworks and libraries. 
 - Experience developing RESTful APIs and microservices. 
 - Experience using automated testing frameworks for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Ability to develop reusable test utilities, fixtures, assertions, data-handling components, and reporting functions. 
 - Understanding of application integration, service communication, and test automation design. 

Preferred

- Experience with TypeScript-based backend development. 
 - Familiarity with API automation and UI automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of mocking, service virtualization, contract testing, and test data frameworks. 
 - Experience with performance testing or service reliability frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with banking integration frameworks and transaction-processing services. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

- Experience with functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Knowledge of Agile development and quality engineering practices. 
 - Experience with source control, branching, merging, pull requests, and code reviews. 
 - Familiarity with defect tracking, test management, test reporting, and project collaboration tools. 
 - Understanding of software development lifecycle activities, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance. 
 - Experience with CI/CD concepts, release validation, and automated test execution. 
 - Ability to document technical designs, test scenarios, test results, defects, risks, and release outcomes. 

Preferred

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates. 
 - Familiarity with build and dependency management tools. 
 - Knowledge of application logging, monitoring, observability, and incident management. 
 - Experience with migration testing, data validation, parallel testing, and regression testing.

Security Protocols

Essential

- Understanding of secure software development and secure testing principles.

 - Knowledge of secure API development and service-to-service communication.

Preferred

Experience Requirements

- Minimum 7+ years of experience in Node. js development, software engineering, QA automation, or related technology roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing backend applications using Node. js. 
 - Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining automated testing frameworks and scripts. 
 - Experience with functional, regression, integration, API, UI, and end-to-end testing.

 - Experience collaborating with Business Analysts, Architects, Product Owners, development teams, and testing teams.

Day-to-Day Activities

- Develop, enhance, test, and maintain Node. js applications, RESTful APIs, microservices, and banking integrations. 
 - Collaborate with Business Analysts, Architects, Product Owners, development teams, testing teams, and stakeholders through requirement discussions, planning sessions, reviews, and defect meetings.

Qualifications

Professional Competencies
